notes: The manifest is durable runtime configuration. The stable server only interprets route/source/style/script metadata; all page-owned code remains on runtime. Add, change, or remove routes and assets here without a Vercel deployment. Ice Dragon is an opt-in chat theme; Default remains the first-load selection and the user's explicit choice is persisted locally. Mobile Chat geometry, responsive bounds, response-card polish, first-paint visibility, and narrow-header fitting are consolidated in chat_mobile_viewport_fix.css so the obsolete duplicate responsive-polish request is no longer part of the boot chain. Assistant responses containing code are enhanced by runtime-owned nested code artifact assets that group code, file tabs, controls, and explanatory details inside one bounded response artifact. Streaming uses a final incremental renderer so only the active assistant message is replaced during generation instead of rebuilding the whole conversation DOM on every stream event.
